claim: For Tier B platforms (x, facebook, instagram, tiktok, youtube, threads, linkedin), social_snapshot.py sets verifiability to archive_snapshot in the snapshot.
sub_question: For Tier B platforms, which verifiability label does social_snapshot.py set in the snapshot?
evidence: TIER_B_PLATFORMS lists the seven named platforms. snapshot_tier_b always passes verifiability="archive_snapshot" into _build_snapshot (lookup failure, save failure, and success paths). Self-test asserts snap.get("verifiability") == "archive_snapshot" for every Tier B platform.
notes: Primary in-repo implementation and unit self-check agree; no alternate Tier B label.
